Guidance & outlook: Against this backdrop, I am pleased to share that BSE had a strong start to the financial year, with Q1 FY2027 being the company's best quarterly results on record and the 14th consecutive quarter of record revenues.
Complementing this structural growth, we conducted 23 investor awareness programs during Q1 FY27, reaching over 4,900 participants.
9,955 crores in Q1 FY27, reflecting sustained market participation and strengthening liquidity on the exchange.
Growth & demand: 737 crores, reflecting robust growth in core trading and settlement-related activities.

It may be noted that 54% of the total operating expenses are attributable to regulatory fees and clearing and unsettlement expenses, all of which is directly correlated to increasing transaction volumes.
539 crores, representing a robust year-on-year growth of 62% with a net profit margin of 51%.
Margins & costs: BSE - PUBLIC The operating EBITDA, including contribution to Core SGF, has increased by 67% to Rs.
625 crores, with margins expanding to 67% from 65%.
Capex & expansion: The total number of investor accounts registered on the BSE has reached an impressive 25.8 crores, reflecting the steady expansion of retail participation across the country.
This clearly underscores the true demographic and geographic expansion of India's capital markets.
Our key subsidiaries, the Indian Clearing Corporation Limited, ICCL, and BSE Index Services, continue to scale through new client acquisitions, product innovation, and enhanced technology adoption.
Balance sheet & cash: 6.2 lakh crores through BSE's fundraising platforms across equity, debt, bonds, commercial papers, REITs, InvITs, and municipal bonds, reaffirming the trust placed in BSE's market infrastructure.
There was a provision made with regard to a due's receivable from one of our debtors.
Risks & challenges: Please note that some of our statements made today may be forward -looking in nature and are subjec t to risks and uncertainties.
Indian capital markets continue to demonstrate exceptional resilience against global uncertainties.
This met an immense market demand for hedging and tactical risk management in technology portfolios.
